label: Branding
description: Replace the map name and author credits with your own server branding.

cvars.label: Brand name
cvars.description: Shown where the map name usually appears.

cvars.label: Top field
cvars.description: Shown after the map author credit (line 1).

cvars.label: Bottom field
cvars.description: Shown after the map author credit (line 2).

cvars.label: Connect message
cvars.description: Shown on the awaiting-challenge screen while connecting.

cvars.label: Loaded message
cvars.description: Centre print after clicking Join or Spectate.

cvars.label: Countdown message
cvars.description: Shown mid-screen when the countdown begins.

cvars.label: End of game message
cvars.description: Shown in the text box when the game finishes.

cvars.label: Show map credit
cvars.description: Show the map's author credit before your brand fields.

cvars.label: Prepend map name
cvars.description: Put the map name before the brand name.

cvars.label: Append game type
cvars.description: Add the game type after the brand name.

cvars.label: Rainbow brand name
cvars.description: Show the brand name in rainbow colours.
